newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500 finishes sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500 finishes sharply higher.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures finished sharply higher in moderate trading, hitting a fresh session peak late on buying from locals and Wall Street firms.
Benign inflation data and softer than expected August retail sales laid the foundation for the rally, and technicals stoked the bullish mood.

August consumer prices reinforced the firm tone set on Thursday after tame producer prices. CPI rose 0.1 percent in August overall and excluding volatile food and energy sectors, versus an increase of 0.3 percent in July.
Wall Street had been expecting a 0.2 percent increase for both overall and core rates.
Retail sales rose 0.2 percent and July sales were unrevised at up 0.1 percent. Economists had expected August retail sales to rise 0.7 percent.
The data were widely seen as dampening expectations for a rate hike when policy makers meet September 24, traders said.
December Treasury bond futures soared to a three-week high and December S&P 500 futures soared to a more than 10-week high. December reached 689.00, the highest price since 690.00 set June 1.
Technicians said December was on track to test the contract high at 695.00.
"Another day like today and you're there for sure," an S&P 500 futures trader said.

Technicians said a day or two of consolidation from these levels could ensue early next week, but called pullbacks buying opportunities. One technician said an orderly sell-off to key support from 675.00 to 678.00 would not dim the bright chart outlook.
"As long as it ratchets higher like this, it trades real well," an S&P 500 trader said.
The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for September fell to 95.0 from 95.3 in the final August index, market sources reported.

December S&P 500s finished up 10.75 pts to 688.85, Value Lines rallied 6.50 to 638.00, Midcap 400s added 2.65 pts to 240.60, NYSE Composite firmed 4.75 to 367.85, and December Nikkei 225 ended up 480 to 21,030.0. --Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
